items.title: A suicide bomber in an ambulance packed with explosives kills at least 102 people and wounds 158 outside a hospital in Kabul, Afghanistan.
Kiss nightclub fire: A fire at a nightclub in the southern Brazilian city of Santa Maria kills at least 235 people and injures at least 169 people.
Brazil: A nightclub fire in Santa Maria, Rio Grande do Sul kills at least 242 people.
Syrian security forces kill over 100 civilians across Syria, primarily in the cities of Homs and Daraa.

Conflict in Darfur: Around 100 people have been killed following an Air Raid into the Darfur region of Sudan according to the African Union. Jean Baptiste Natama, the A.U's spokesperson has described it as a "major ceasefire violation".
Nigeria: The Lagos Armoury Explosion killed at least 1,100 people and displaced over 20,000.
